description: I'm a Software Developer focused on Java, Spring Boot, databases, and distributed systems. I enjoy designing APIs, caching, messaging, and practical system design. I'm also exploring AI engineering—LLMs, MCP, and agentic patterns for real applications.

about.summary: I'm a Software Developer interested in building reliable backend applications and scalable systems. My work centers on Spring Boot, relational databases, Redis, and messaging patterns used in production-style projects.
paragraphs: I'm actively building KINNOTE (a family memory platform) and Redis Engineering Lab (a hands-on Spring Boot + Redis laboratory) while working as a Software Developer in Bengaluru.
I care about clear boundaries between services, cache invalidation, transactional workflows, and observable failure modes—not just happy-path tutorials.
I'm exploring AI engineering with a backend lens: how LLMs, MCP, and agents integrate with APIs and data you already trust.
